deploybot: [deploy] Build started for tag v2.14.0-canary (commit abc1234) · env=canary · pipeline: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/3456

mike-s: which jobs are in this run? any flaky suites we should watch?

deploybot: jobs: build, lint, unit-tests, integration-kv, e2e-smoke. ETA ~12m. notif on fail.

sophie: lint just failed on the packages stage in my local repro earlier, errors from eslint rule `no-restricted-syntax` after the new prettier bump.

deploybot: LINT job failed · job=lint-packages · step=eslint · exit=1

jen-oncall: can you paste the eslint output? might be fast to patch.

sophie: here — failing files: packages/serve/src/runner.ts
```
packages/serve/src/runner.ts:12:5 - error  Using 'for..of' is restricted. (no-restricted-syntax)
  10 | async function run() {
  11 |   // iterate tasks
> 12 |   for (const step of steps) {
     |     ^
  13 |     await step.execute();
  14 |   }
```

mike-s: that change came in via commit abc1234 which updated eslint config. we can either pin to previous config, revert that commit, or ``eslint-disable`` as a short-term workaround.

anya: what's impact to canary if we hold? are we blocking the release window?

jen-oncall: current change window is open for 2 more hours. we should avoid pushing a canary with failing lint — it will fail preflight checks for Dedicated later.

qa-bot: integration-kv test showed a transient failure 3/10 runs last week: `kv-cache-smoke` timeout 30s -> 60s in CI helps sometimes. not the current blocker (lint is).

mike-s: I can open a hotfix PR that reverts the eslint-config bump and push commit cherry-pick `hotfix/lint-pin-3050001111` — then we rerun pipeline on that branch.

anya: agree. create the PR and tag me + release ops. if hotfix fixes lint we'll promote, else we revert the whole change.

sophie: I'll also add a small eslint exception in runner.ts with `// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax` to keep the change minimal if needed. prefer revert though.

deploybot: New PR created: https://git.redwood.internal/pulls/789 · branch=hotfix/lint-pin-3050001111 · from=abc1234~1 -> cherry-pick fix 

deploybot: Triggering pipeline rerun on branch hotfix/lint-pin-3050001111 (build/lint/unit/integration) · queued by mike-s

jen-oncall: good call. hold canary for now. we'll retest the canary once the hotfix pipeline passes.

anya: checklist: 1) PR merged -> 2) pipeline green -> 3) canary promote. if pipeline fails again we roll back the eslint bump permanently.

mike-s: running `ci retry --pipeline 3456 --branch hotfix/lint-pin-3050001111` now. pinging on results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

qa-bot: I'll run a targeted kv-cache-smoke run after lint passes to be safe.

deploybot: Pipeline update: lint=running · unit-tests=queued · integration=queued

mike-s: thumbs up. thanks everyone. will update PR with logs soon.

deploybot: (scheduled) If hotfix pipeline passes, will auto-promote canary candidate in 10m unless hold label present.

anya: leave hold label until we confirm e2e-smoke is stable.

deploybot: Noted. hold label applied by anya. will not auto-promote.

mike-s: end-to-end plan: if hotfix passes and e2e-smoke ok -> promote canary -> monitor 30m -> start gradual rollout. otherwise we'll block and schedule rollback of eslint-config bump.
